full_name: Peter Kronheimer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Mathematics Suzanne Young Murray Fellow Harvard University
bio: Peter Kronheimer is the William Caspar Graustein Professor of Mathematics at Harvard University, where his research focuses on the interface between geometry and topology, particularly the topology of manifolds in low dimension.
